title: Starbucks Mobile Order & Pay outage, Nov 20, 2026
disclaimer: Made for entertainment using AI. Not endorsed by Starbucks, any government agency, news outlet, company, or anyone else named.
size_basis: Starbucks Mobile Order & Pay is used across the US. The tracker's reports peaked at about 73 times normal for roughly six hours. Starbucks has not said how many customers or orders were affected.
who_is_affected: US customers who order or pay in the Starbucks app. Stores and drive-thrus stayed open. If you were charged for an order that never arrived, check your app history and ask Starbucks support.

known.text: Customers in the US saw errors, zero balances and failed payments in the Starbucks app on Friday, Nov 20.

not_known.text: What caused the problem. Starbucks has said only that there was an issue.
Whether it was a cyberattack. No source reports one, and nothing has ruled one out.
How many customers and orders were affected.
Whether customers were charged for orders that failed, and how refunds will work.
Whether Starbucks says service is fully restored.
